summary: Split-origin enterprise SPA with an external OIDC IdP, hybrid cookie/Bearer tenant auth, introspection-disabled GraphQL, interactive admin tabs/modals and a stored XSS rendered only in the authenticated admin view.

findings.title: Stored XSS in note body renders in the authenticated admin moderation view
findings.impact: script execution in an authenticated admin browser session (session/token theft, admin action forgery)
evidence: member inbox escapes the same stored body
admin ?tab=inbox renders the stored body as rich HTML

findings.title: GraphQL member resolver ignores the caller tenant
findings.impact: cross-tenant member profile disclosure (email, role, tenant)
evidence: member(id: "u-beta-1") returns bob@beta from a tenant-alpha token

findings.title: Admin member export requires authentication but not the admin role
findings.impact: any member token dumps every tenant's member directory
evidence: tenant-alpha member token receives tenant-beta rows and the beta export canary

findings.title: Session refresh trusts JWT claims without verifying the signature (alg none)
findings.impact: self-signed alg:none token with role=admin yields an admin session token
evidence: forged payload sub=u-alpha-1 role=admin is accepted

findings.title: OIDC authorize endpoint does not allowlist redirect_uri
findings.impact: authorization codes are delivered to an attacker-controlled origin (account takeover after interception)
evidence: redirect_uri=https://evil.example/steal returns 302 to that origin with a fresh code

chains.title: Member-to-admin tenant compromise
chains.description: A member stores markup that executes in the admin moderation view, then the same member token pulls the tenant-wide member export without a role check.

decoys.reason: REST profile compares X-Tenant-Id with the token tenant and returns 403 cross-tenant.
Introspection is disabled server-side; the error is intended hardening, not a finding.
Public CDN application shell contains no secrets or tenant data.
